description: Check a draft against the writer's house rules with the Sniff Test linter. Use when the user says /snifftest, hands you a Markdown or text file and asks whether it passes, asks which house rules a draft trips, or asks for a style or prose check on something they wrote. Reports the rule, the line and how sure the checker is, so the prose can be fixed rather than argued about.
